purpose: Make a later event depend on a completed condition.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
た-form + ら; copula だったら.
If it rains, I will stay home.
Please call when you reach the station.
When I got home, no one was there.
Choose a conditional that fits the situation
formation: た-form + ら; copula だったら.
restrictions: May express a hypothetical condition or a time when something happens.
mistake: The past-looking form does not necessarily place the condition in past time.
